sessions.phase_label: Illustration specification, revision, and final delivery

requirements.title: Hand-Drawn Non-AI Artwork
requirements.definition: The commissioned illustrations must be produced as hand-drawn vector artwork without using AI-generated artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the production-method constraint across the commissioned artwork, not individual illustration content or final export formats.

requirements.title: Final Image File Delivery
requirements.definition: The completed illustration set must be delivered in the client-selected PNG and JPG image formats.
requirements.boundary_note: PNG and JPG are attributes of one final-delivery mechanism; design-specific crops and background variants remain separate obligations.

requirements.title: Bottle and Cloud Slogan Illustration
requirements.definition: The referenced bottle illustration must display the campfire slogan above the bottle using the requested cloud-like typography, exact wording, font, spelling, and line arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Bottle choice, slogan wording, Cloud Sketch font, spelling, and two-line layout are coupled attributes of this illustration rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Stamped Meat Slogan Illustration
requirements.definition: The referenced food illustration must use the requested cartoon treatment and show the campfire slogan as a legible stamped mark on the meat without visual streaks interfering with it.
requirements.boundary_note: Cartoon styling, tortilla appearance, steak streak placement, and stamped text are attributes of one identifiable food-design mechanism.

requirements.title: Steak and Onion Grill Illustration
requirements.definition: The grill illustration must contain steak and onions, use the requested cartoon treatment, and render the campfire slogan as readable smoke.
requirements.boundary_note: Grill contents, steak shape, cartoon styling, and smoke-text readability are coupled attributes of this independently reviewable illustration.

requirements.title: Riverton Sky Text Illustration
requirements.definition: The referenced illustration must include a large text bubble spanning the sky and use the place name Riverton instead of Meadowbrook.
requirements.boundary_note: The text-bubble scale and Riverton copy replacement are attributes of one identifiable illustration.

requirements.title: Green and Transparent PNG Variants
requirements.definition: Each referenced completed design must be supplied in two PNG variants: one with a green background and one without the green background.
requirements.boundary_note: The paired background variants form one export obligation, but the missing attachment context leaves unresolved whether messages 42 and 43 concern one design or two independently deliverable designs.

requirements.title: Standalone Strawberry Composition
requirements.definition: A standalone PNG must show the strawberry with the bottle and grill, retain the complete bottle and smoke without clipping, and omit the unwanted pineapple text from the bottle.
requirements.boundary_note: Composition, unclipped elements, and bottle-label cleanup are attributes of the independently requested standalone strawberry export.

unresolved_candidates.description: The repeated campfire slogan strongly suggests one bottle-and-cloud illustration, but attachment-free evidence cannot conclusively prove that all typography changes target the same design.

A referenced illustration must be made more cartoon-like, but the unavailable example or attachment prevents safe mapping to an existing design or establishment of a distinct illustration Requirement.
The nearly identical background-variant requests may concern two different completed illustrations or may duplicate one request; attachment context is required before splitting the Requirement.
The client requires a lighter or cleared background behind a word, but the affected illustration cannot be identified from the supplied text.
A remaining visual issue was reported and claimed fixed, but the empty intervening attachment and coreferential wording do not identify the affected Requirement or behavior.
